import sys

def articulationPoints(V, adj):
    def dfs(at, parent, low, disc, visited, ap):
        children = 0
        visited[at] = True
        disc[at] = low[at] = time[0]
        time[0] += 1
        for neighbor in adj[at]:
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                children += 1
                dfs(neighbor, at, low, disc, visited, ap)
                low[at] = min(low[at], low[neighbor])
                if parent != -1 and low[neighbor] >= disc[at]:
                    ap.add(at)
            elif neighbor != parent:
                low[at] = min(low[at], disc[neighbor])
        if parent == -1 and children > 1:
            ap.add(at)

    visited = [False] * V
    disc = [float('inf')] * V
    low = [float('inf')] * V
    ap = set()
    time = [0]
    for i in range(V):
        if not visited[i]:
            dfs(i, -1, low, disc, visited, ap)
    return sorted(ap) if ap else [-1]

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
V = int(input[0])
adj = [[] for _ in range(V)]
index = 1
for i in range(V):
    while index < len(input) and input[index] != '-1':
        adj[i].append(int(input[index]))
        index += 1
    index += 1
print(articulationPoints(V, adj))
